reading: Measured: about 28 frames per second on average over 113 s, median frame 33 ms, 5 percent of frames above 57 ms, one 785 ms stall. The audit's acceptance bar (p95 frame time at or under 33.3 ms) is not met, although the user perceives the game as fluid.
Measured: Quantum's update takes a median 12.8 ms of each frame at 116 s, with 6.9 predicted ticks re-simulated per frame on average at a ping of 60 to 90 ms.

Measured trend: median frame time rose from 24 ms to 33 ms and median simulation time from 7.8 ms to 12.8 ms between 34 s and 116 s. Cause not attributed (more active entities, thermal throttling, or longer frames carrying more ticks).
notAttributed: Share of the frame spent outside the simulation (rendering, scripts, browser): this overlay version did not measure main-thread busy time.
Cause of the stalls above 100 ms (candidates: first-use shader compilation, WebAssembly heap growth from 32 MB, garbage collection, view instantiation, checksum computation every 60 ticks).
Whether the frame loop was paced by requestAnimationFrame or by a timer (target frame rate not displayed).
nextTest: Rebuild with the extended overlay, then run solo on the phone as room creator with URL overrides: baseline, checksum=0, hz=30, fps=-1, quality=1; compare readings at the same session time.
